tokens.name: surface-base
tokens.usage: Screen background (grouped background in SwiftUI terms).

tokens.name: surface-elevated
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, grouped rows on surface-base.

tokens.name: surface-control
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, progress-bar track, unselected fills.

tokens.name: surface-control-selected
tokens.usage: Selected segment in a segmented control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on any surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, section headers on surface tokens.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Template region outlines and unpainted numerals; hairlines.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Unpainted template regions and the template canvas. Also the label colour on nightshade, midnight, oxblood and moss.

tokens.name: nightshade
tokens.usage: Signature colour: primary buttons (paper text), selection, the hill in the app icon.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: SwiftUI accent/tint for text buttons and links: antique gold in dark mode, nightshade in light.

tokens.name: pot-1-midnight
tokens.usage: Paint pot 1; app-icon sky. Label in paper.

tokens.name: pot-2-oxblood
tokens.usage: Paint pot 2. Label in paper.

tokens.name: pot-3-gold
tokens.usage: Paint pot 3; stars, crescent and sparkles (in the icon, a subtle #EDD089→#B98F32 gradient). Label in ink (light).

tokens.name: pot-4-moss
tokens.usage: Paint pot 4. Label in paper, bold and 17pt or larger only.

tokens.name: pot-5-rose
tokens.usage: Paint pot 5. Label in ink (light).

tokens.name: pot-6-lavender
tokens.usage: Paint pot 6. Label in ink (light).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside a segmented control; tight icon gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between label and value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins, card padding, gap between stacked sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between major groups; generous card padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segments inside a segmented control (track uses 9px).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, grouped cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Template preview card, large media.
